    },

      "revenue_cr": 1950,
      "net_income_cr": 50,

  "top_assumptions": [
    "Gradual recovery in Total Income driven by partial stabilisation of loan book, resumption of limited disbursements post-COVID caution, and improvement in interest collections as Stage-3 NPA resolution progresses \u2014 projected at ~10-12% revenue CAGR over FY2022-24 from the depressed FY2021 base of Rs.1,397 crore.",
    "Net losses narrow sharply as the elevated FY2021 impairment/provisioning charge of Rs.2,272 crore (standalone) mean-reverts toward normalised levels; NPA coverage is now high (~64% provision coverage) reducing the need for fresh large provisions, and the new Stage-3 income non-recognition policy (effective April 2021) removes a recurring drag on reported income quality."
  ],
  "reasoning": "IFCI is a classic anomaly case: FY2021 Total Income (standalone) collapsed to Rs.1,397 crore from Rs.2,264 crore in FY2020 and Rs.2,466 crore in FY2019, a two-year revenue CAGR of approximately -25%, driven by COVID-related zero new disbursements (only Rs.77 crore vs Rs.742 crore prior year), accelerated Stage-3 NPA income de-recognition, and massive loan prepayments shrinking the book. FY2021 is therefore NOT representative and using its year-on-year decline as a projection basis would be misleading. Instead, mean-reversion toward the FY2019 income base is assumed over 2-3 years, with a modest 10-12% annual recovery rate, constrained by the still-elevated NPA ratio (Gross NPA ~50%, Net NPA ratio high), negative CRAR (-10.8%), and continued balance-sheet deleveraging (financial liabilities down from Rs.17,946 crore in FY2019 to Rs.12,765 crore in FY2021). Net losses are forecast to narrow progressively as fresh provisioning requirements moderate from the Rs.2,271 crore peak, with a return to marginal profitability only by FY2024; EPS is computed on approximately 1,896 crore shares (FY2021 share capital of Rs.1,896 crore at Rs.10 face value = ~189.6 crore shares)."
}

Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).
